itens.trecho: Belíssimo! Realmente, é muito impressionante. Assisti duas vezes e, em ambas as ocasiões, fiquei surpreso com a beleza desse filme. Ele me prendeu muito tempo, tava curtindo a história e tudo mais, porém começou a ficar exaustivo e o final é longo demais e deixou um gostinho amargo.

My rating: 10/10 Why? I rate any movie based on a few things. Warning! Potential Spoilers. 1. Story. Is the story compelling, does it stick in your mind after the movie, haunting you like a ghost, forcing you to think about it and even your own life? Does it have any positive messages aka moral of the story.

I don't mind the repetition of the first movie's plot. To be frank, I couldn't care less. I've only ever watched these movies for the visuals. But the part of the story that rubbed me the wrong way the most in this movie, Is Neytiri.
